strategy_transitions.reason: The constrained search produced an official TikTok channel frontier but no direct canonical video URL; inspecting that public official result is a new falsifiable surface and does not replay P54.

strategy_transitions.to: official public structured Creative Center inspection
strategy_transitions.reason: The channel fetch failed technically, while the search-index response independently exposed an official Creative Center frontier with stable public video IDs.

strategy_transitions.from: official public structured Creative Center inspection
strategy_transitions.reason: Creative Center exposed stable video IDs without creator mapping; official oEmbed was the next authorized resolver for canonical creator and URL metadata.
The resolver returned official stable identity and canonical metadata but the first broad-diving candidate was irrelevant; a bounded batch was needed to find scuba records.
All fifteen batch attempts failed before provider connection, so a separately approved network context tested whether a multi-record official surface could preserve the remaining budget.

Twenty-seven of forty new outbound attempts are consumed. A valid ten-record final set still requires at least twenty official per-URL verifications across two live rounds, before any further discovery, which would exceed the immutable request ceiling.

phase_outcome.stop_condition: more than 40 new outbound requests is required

conclusion: Official TikTok oEmbed reproducibly resolved one Creative Center video ID to official creator and canonical metadata, proving a viable per-URL verification technique, but the candidate was not scuba-relevant. Public search, channel, profile and Creative Center surfaces did not produce a retained canonical scuba set, and fifteen preconnect failures were conservatively charged to the outbound budget. Completing ten relevant records and verifying all ten in two live rounds now requires more than the thirteen remaining attempts, so P57 stops fail-closed without adapter, Registry V3, fixture, MTC, PR or merge.
